content: How many men did Moses send to spy out Canaan, one from each tribe?
explanation: Each was a tribal leader. “From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.” (Numbers 13:2, BSB)

content: What did the twelve spies carry on a pole between two men?
explanation: The land was very fruitful. “they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men.” (Numbers 13:23, BSB)

content: How many days did the twelve spies explore Canaan?
explanation: Then they returned to Moses. “After forty days the men returned from spying out the land” (Numbers 13:25, BSB)

content: The twelve spies said Canaan was flowing with what?
explanation: It was a good land. “and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey.” (Numbers 13:27, BSB)

content: Which spy said, “We can certainly conquer it!”?
explanation: He trusted God. “Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, “We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!”” (Numbers 13:30, BSB)

content: Beside Canaan's giants, the fearful spies said they seemed like what?
explanation: Fear made them feel small. “We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight” (Numbers 13:33, BSB)

content: Which two spies tore their clothes and urged Israel to trust God?
explanation: They said the land was very good. “Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes” (Numbers 14:6, BSB)

content: After the spies' bad report, who alone of that generation would enter Canaan?
explanation: They had trusted God. “except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.” (Numbers 14:30, BSB)

content: What animal did Balaam ride when going with the princes of Moab?
explanation: God had a lesson for him. “So in the morning Balaam got up, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.” (Numbers 22:21, BSB)

content: What did Balaam's donkey see standing in the road?
explanation: He held a drawn sword. “When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand” (Numbers 22:23, BSB)

content: What amazing thing did the LORD let Balaam's donkey do?
explanation: She asked why he beat her. “Then the LORD opened the donkey’s mouth, and she said to Balaam” (Numbers 22:28, BSB)

content: How many times had Balaam beaten his donkey when she spoke?
explanation: She had turned from the angel. “What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times?” (Numbers 22:28, BSB)

content: When Balaam's donkey saw the angel in a narrow place, what did she do?
explanation: There was no room to turn. “When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam” (Numbers 22:27, BSB)

content: When the LORD opened Balaam's eyes, what did Balaam do?
explanation: He saw the angel with a sword. “And Balaam bowed low and fell facedown.” (Numbers 22:31, BSB)

content: After meeting the angel, what was Balaam allowed to speak?
explanation: God controlled his words. “but you are to speak only what I tell you.” (Numbers 22:35, BSB)

content: How does the priestly blessing in Numbers begin?
explanation: Aaron's sons blessed Israel. “May the LORD bless you and keep you” (Numbers 6:24, BSB)

content: In Numbers, how is Moses described, more than any man on earth?
explanation: He did not seek glory. “Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.” (Numbers 12:3, BSB)

content: In Numbers, what did Moses put on a pole to heal bitten Israelites?
explanation: Whoever looked at it lived. “So Moses made a bronze snake and mounted it on a pole.” (Numbers 21:9, BSB)

content: The priestly blessing in Numbers ends asking the LORD to give you what?
explanation: May He lift His face toward you. “may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.” (Numbers 6:26, BSB)

content: In Numbers, how did the cloud over the tabernacle look at night?
explanation: God's presence led Israel. “the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.” (Numbers 9:16, BSB)

content: In Numbers, what food did complaining Israelites say they were tired of?
explanation: They wanted meat instead. “there is nothing to see but this manna!” (Numbers 11:6, BSB)

content: In Numbers, how many years did Israel wander, a year for each spying day?
explanation: They refused to trust God. “In keeping with the forty days you spied out the land, you shall bear your guilt forty years—a year for each day” (Numbers 14:34, BSB)

content: In Numbers, whose staff sprouted, blossomed, and produced almonds?
explanation: God chose Levi's house. “and saw that Aaron’s staff, representing the house of Levi, had sprouted, put forth buds, blossomed, and produced almonds.” (Numbers 17:8, BSB)

content: In Numbers, what did Moses do to the rock instead of speaking to it?
explanation: Water still gushed out. “Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff” (Numbers 20:11, BSB)

content: In Numbers, why could Moses and Aaron not lead Israel into the land?
explanation: They struck the rock. “Because you did not trust Me to show My holiness in the sight of the Israelites” (Numbers 20:12, BSB)

content: In Numbers, Balaam says God is not a man, that He should do what?
explanation: God keeps His promises. “God is not a man, that He should lie” (Numbers 23:19, BSB)

content: In Numbers, whom did God tell Moses to lay hands on as the next leader?
explanation: He had the Spirit in him. “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.” (Numbers 27:18, BSB)

content: In Numbers, which giant people did the spies see in Canaan?
explanation: Their size frightened the spies. “We even saw the descendants of Anak there.” (Numbers 13:28, BSB)

content: In which valley did the spies cut the great cluster of grapes?
explanation: Eshcol means cluster. “When they came to the Valley of Eshcol” (Numbers 13:23, BSB)

content: Where was Israel camped when the twelve spies returned?
explanation: In the Wilderness of Paran. “in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh.” (Numbers 13:26, BSB)

content: In Numbers, which vegetables did Israel miss from Egypt?
explanation: They also missed fish and melons. “along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.” (Numbers 11:5, BSB)

content: In Numbers, in which wilderness did the LORD speak to Moses at the start of the book?
explanation: It was the second year after Egypt. “the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai.” (Numbers 1:1, BSB)

content: Which king's princes did Balaam travel with?
explanation: Balak was king of Moab. “So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.” (Numbers 22:35, BSB)

content: What did Balaam's donkey crush against a vineyard wall?
explanation: She was avoiding the angel. “crushing Balaam’s foot against it.” (Numbers 22:25, BSB)

content: In Numbers, what was a bitten Israelite to do to live?
explanation: Jesus compared Himself to this. “When anyone who is bitten looks at it, he will live.” (Numbers 21:8, BSB)
